description:
Add `otto repo` subcommands for managing the repos list in the config file without hand-editing YAML.

Subcommands:
- `otto repo list` — print all currently watched repos with their trigger keyword (if overridden) and runner assignment
- `otto repo add <owner/repo>` — append a repo to the watched list; accepts optional flags `--trigger <keyword>` and `--runner <runner-id>` to override per-repo defaults; validates the repo exists and the token has access before writing
- `otto repo remove <owner/repo>` — remove a repo from the watched list; errors if not present

All subcommands read from and write to the config file in place, preserving comments and formatting where possible (use a YAML library that round-trips cleanly, or write a note that comments may be lost on write).

Print a confirmation of what changed after each mutating command.
title: otto repo — add, remove, and list watched repos
